title: Dlgh1 knockdown in primary OT-1 T lymphocytes
protocol: Keep everything RNAase free including gloves, tubes, reagents and use barrier tips.
Wash a purified population of T cells once in unsupplemented RPMI 1640 media.
Resuspend the washed cells at a concentration of 4 X 10^6 /ml in unsupplemented media.
Aliquot 500 μl of the cell suspension into each well of a 24 well plate (2 X 10^6 cells/well).
Combine 84 μl of Buffer EC-R, 6.5 μl of enhancer R, and 9.7 μl of a 20 μM solution of double-stranded annealed Dlgh1 siRNA per sample.
Vortex the combined reagents and allow to sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add 11 μl of Qiagen Transmessenger transfection Reagent/sample.
Vortex again and allow to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Prepare a similar solution using control siRNA oligo (purchased from Qiagen against the target sequence AAT TCT CCG AAC GTG TCA CGT).
Add 400 μl of incomplete RPMI 1640 media supplemented with 200U/ml of IL-2 to the combined reagents per sample.
Add 500 μl of this mixture (siRNA, Transmessenger reagents and media) to your cells in a dropwise fashion.
Gently swirl and place back in incubator for 3-4 hours.
Spin cells out of transfection media.
Resuspend cells at 2 X 10^6 /ml in complete media supplemented with 200 U/ml of IL-2 for splenic culture.
